title: Ron Johnson sees the Milky Way from a distance

tellings.quote: They say, "Ron, where would you like to go?" Said, "I'd like to see the Milky Way from a distance."

plain: A man named Ron Johnson is said to have been asked by the beings he met, "Ron, where would you like to go?", and to have answered that he would like to see the Milky Way, our galaxy, from a distance. The researcher Grant Cameron relays this as something Johnson told, and it would mean non-human beings offered a person a trip far beyond Earth.
